name: vercel-imc-a2a-deploy-agent
description: Restores and verifies Vercel production deployments from GitHub/Vercel events using ICM folder-stage orchestration.

authentication.description: Use Authorization: Bearer $A2A_SHARED_SECRET for mutating/task calls. Agent card can be public.

skills.name: GitHub webhook production deploy
skills.description: Accepts GitHub push/deployment notifications, resolves Vercel project, deploys approved production branch, and verifies visibility.
examples: Deploy owner/repo main to production and verify the hero section is visible.

skills.name: Vercel visibility sweep
skills.description: Inventories GitHub repos and Vercel projects, then reports which projects are 404, blocked, failing, or visible.
examples: Sweep all repos under executiveusa and report deployment blockers without editing source code.

skills.name: No-code deployment triage
skills.description: Diagnoses build and routing blockers using logs, Vercel metadata, and browser checks; stops when source-code changes are required.
examples: Find why this Vercel app shows 404 and report the safe fix path.
